core_question: Which H15 directions can a fresh horizontal position strip strictly tighten?
theorem: For compact convex X and closed measurement set M with nonempty intersection, h_{X intersect M}(q)=h_X(q) iff the q-exposed face of X intersects M.
status: theorem proved analytically; 160/160 is numerical evidence for the finite 1390-term zonotope only, not an infinite-tail proof
consequence: For the frozen finite approximation, a fresh position measurement can improve every H15 directional support; therefore no nontrivial direction can be removed from eager refresh merely because its vector is not a position coordinate.
